_comment: Animation manifest for Scape. Pre-2D, no rendering engine yet. This file describes every animation the game will ever need so animators (human or AI) can produce frames and the engine knows timing, looping, and frame count when sprites land. Naming: action_variation_direction. Directions use 8-way compass where needed (n/ne/e/se/s/sw/w/nw). Defaults are conservative; individual entries override.

humanoid_default.notes: long idle after 8 seconds without input
more elaborate hand motion, darker sparks
altar-light fade-in at Heartlands respawn point

attack_special_dark_bow.notes: two dragon arrows fired in sequence

attack_special_saradomin_godsword.notes: heavy overhead swing, healing flash on hit

mining.notes: pick raises, strikes rock, sparks; sprite swap per pick tier (bronze..crystal)

fishing_rod.notes: rod held, bob dips, catch tug

slayer_use_item.notes: mirror shield raise, ice cooler, etc.

monster_animations.notes: wing beats slow in idle, fast in fly; frost breath has 2-frame windup
phase-2 transition shows cloak burn away
always hovering; feet never touch ground
three-phase serpent; rotation animation keeps water splash continuous
three-head animation; each head fires separately
last-dragon boss; cycles all breath elements
requires earmuffs to fight — wail inaudible through muffs

fx_animations.description: small yellow burst above player head
altar-light column, 3-tier shimmer, briefly desaturates surroundings
player dissolves bottom-up into blue motes
body breaks into motes, gravestone rises
gravestone glows faint until timer ends
gold spiral rises from dropped pet item
item glows gold, vanishes, coin stack rises
red aura wraps player, pulses once
red counter-burst when the spell fires
UI bar pulse when special available
subtle yellow glyph rises — Marstead 'minor' tier
reserved for the handful of transformative thresholds; screen briefly stills
one-time cinematic reveal on first entry to Crystal Caverns
cloak burns away; one-time per fight

environmental_animations.description: light rain overlay for weather system
